FMI specification families recognized by VeraGrid.

is_legacy_governor_dynamic_reference() → bool[source]

Return whether this key could identify an old governor dynamic value.

Historical governor files wrote editable model parameters to both Block.event_dict and Block.api_obj_mapping. These references are retained in the enumeration so those files remain readable. The parser must additionally verify the complete legacy governor mapping signature, because P0 is also a runtime operating-point reference in converter models.

Returns:

Whether this reference can identify an old governor dynamic value.

is_runtime_parameter_reference() → bool[source]

Return whether this key identifies a special runtime operating value.

Generator sharing targets and converter operating controls depend on the initialized operating point and use dedicated runtime initialization paths. This classification does not decide whether a general API mapping target belongs to Block.parameters or Block.event_dict; that role is declared by the target block itself.

Returns:

Whether the key uses a special operating-point runtime path.
